headline_pain: Rates Are Up. So Is Your Rent.
headline_outcome: At Least a Mortgage Builds Equity
primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." Here's the thing — your landlord already factored rate rises into your rent increase. You're paying for higher rates either way. The difference? A mortgage payment builds equity. Rent builds nothing. Smart business owners across Melbourne's west are locking in off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina at today's prices. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. You're already paying the cost of high rates through rent. At least own something for it.
description: You're already paying for rate rises through rent — own something instead
